thread:
toni (new-dev): Hey all, running the docker quickstart and first call returns 403 with body: {"error":"workspace_blocked","msg":"workspace requires billing"}. I set REDWOOD_API_KEY in my env and passed -e into docker.

nora (devex): Welcome! Which sample image and SDK version? Quickstarts sometimes have mismatched env names between .env.example and container entrypoint.

toni (new-dev): examples/node: `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$KEY redwood/quickstart-node`. Logs show `token=undefined` before the 403.

ben (sdk): If the container entrypoint doesn't export the env, the process won't see it. Also note recent SDK changes: missing key no longer silently falls back and some billing-limited responses come back as workspace_blocked. Try `docker exec -it <id> env | grep REDWOOD` to confirm inside.

toni (new-dev): Ran env inside container and it's empty. The sample compose uses API_KEY in .env.example, not REDWOOD_API_KEY. I missed that.

irene (billing): I checked your org (toni-sandbox): status "Payment info incomplete". Workspaces in that state will get workspace_blocked on protected routes. We can enable a 48h dev unlock if you DM org id.

toni (new-dev): Ah — I also closed the billing SSO popup earlier thinking it was optional. Didn't realize it left the workspace blocked.

nora (devex): Action items: (1) quick README PR to align sample env var names to REDWOOD_API_KEY and mention docker entrypoint, (2) ask SDK to print clearer diagnostic when auth env missing and server returns workspace_blocked. I'm filing both.

onboard-bot: Auto: Created ticket BILL-6019 assigned to irene for dev unlock.

irene (billing): Enabled 48h dev unlock for your org; should be live in ~30s. Also DMing steps to complete billing to avoid future blocks.

tonI (new-dev): Rebuilt with both API_KEY and REDWOOD_API_KEY set and retrying — first call now returns 200. Thanks everyone!

ben (sdk): I'll add a tiny guard in the quickstart to fail fast with a friendly message if REDWOOD_API_KEY is unset in containerized runs.

nora (devex): I'll land the README tweak and pin SDK >= the fix. Saving this thread for others who hit env mismatch + SSO/billing trap. :thumbsup:
